new_jobs.jd: Responsible for translating agreed demand signals and business priorities into feasible supply, build, and shipment plans for the assigned product portfolio. The role serves as an execution interface among Demand Planning, Product Groups, Sales, Customer Service/GAO, Manufacturing, OSAT Planning, Engineering, Quality, and Logistics to align demand with available supply, capacity, inventory, and operational readiness. The position identifies constraints, recommends recovery actions, and coordinates cross-functional execution to support customer commitments and business objectives. **Job Description** •Develop and maintain feasible supply, build, and shipment plans based on agreed demand, business priorities, capacity, inventory, and operational readiness. •Support medium- and long-term capacity reviews by identifying requirements that may exceed available capacity, materials, or manufacturing capability. •Monitor demand and supply conditions and identify shortages, constraints, excess supply, and potential delivery risks. •Maintain realistic RFD and customer commitments based on executable supply and escalate gaps when commitments cannot be supported. •Assess supply constraints and develop recovery, allocation, pull-in, or alternative fulfilment scenarios for management consideration. •Execute approved allocation and prioritization decisions and ensure changes are reflected in the relevant planning and order-management systems. •Coordinate across Demand Planning, Product Groups, Sales, Customer Service/GAO, Manufacturing, OSAT Planning, Engineering, Quality, and Logistics to maintain alignment and resolve supply issues. •Monitor inventory and WIP health, including excess, ageing, and no-demand exposure, and recommend appropriate actions. •Provide clear supply-demand visibility, risk assessments, recovery status, and recommendations to support timely business decisions. •Maintain accurate planning data and use Rapid Response, ERP, Excel, and other analytical tools to support planning and scenario analysis. •Identify and support process, reporting, data-quality, and planning improvements to improve supply-chain execution. **Qualifications** • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Management, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in supply chain, supply planning, production planning, or a manufacturing environment. • Experience in semiconductor front-end, back-end, or OSAT planning is preferred. • Good understanding of semiconductor assembly, test, pack, qualification, PCN, allocation, and fulfilment processes. •Experience of working across different countries, business units, and external manufacturing partners. •Experience with Kinaxis Rapid Response is preferred. •Experience with Oracle, SAP, or similar ERP/order-management systems. •Analytical and problem-solving ability to identify supply issues and support practical solutions. •Ability to work effectively across functions, coordinate stakeholders, and follow up actions to closure. •Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications; advanced Excel and data-analysis skills are preferred. •Good written and verbal communication skills. •Able to work effectively under pressure, manage changing priorities, and meet critical deadlines. •Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability. •Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional **Additional Information** Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier** . new_jobs.jd: **Job Description & Summary** 想將你的技術洞察，轉化為驅動企業未來成長的策略藍圖嗎？ 在 PwC，你將不只是一位顧問，更是客戶信賴的轉型夥伴。你將深入企業營運的核心，運用你的專業，協助客戶應對複雜的技術挑戰，將 IT 策略與商業目標緊密結合，並在轉型過程中創造實質且長遠的價值。 At PwC, our people in strategy consulting focus on providing strategic guidance and insights to organisations. They analyse market trends, assess business performance, and develop recommendations to help clients achieve their goals. These individuals work closely with clients to identify opportunities for growth, optimise operations, and enhance overall business performance. In technology strategy at PwC, you will specialise in developing and implementing strategic plans to leverage technology for business growth and innovation. You will analyse market trends, assess organisational needs, and provide guidance on technology investments and initiatives. Working in this area, you will collaborate with stakeholders to align technology strategies with overall business objectives to increase utilisation of technology resources, driving competitive advantage. **你將負責的工作** * 為企業客戶診斷 IT 現況與風險，擘劃兼具商業效益的技術發展藍圖與投資策略。 * 主導或參與大型 IT 專案的規劃、執行與管理，確保專案目標如期如質交付。 * 優化 IT 組織的運作流程與治理框架，導入服務管理與績效衡量機制，提升整體營運效能。 * 擔任企業 IT 與業務單位的橋樑，發掘流程中的數位化契機，並推動轉型方案落地。 **背景／能力要求** * 具備 3-5 年以上相關經驗，來自企業 IT 單位、轉型辦公室，或曾於顧問、系統整合商參與大型技術導入或數位轉型專案。 * 擁有扎實的專案管理知識與實務經驗，能駕馭跨部門、跨系統的複雜專案。 * 具備敏銳的商業思維與財務概念，能將技術解決方案與企業的投資回報連結。 * 擁有卓越的邏輯分析、簡報製作與溝通能力，能與內外部高階主管有效對話（具備流利英文溝通能力者尤佳）。 **【加分條件】** ■ 曾參與以下任一類型工作： * 整合多個事業單位/多國或多系統的大型 IT 專案 * 整體 IT 規劃、IT 組織調整、IT 治理或 IT 預算管理 * 併購或重大投資案中的 IT 評估（IT Due Diligence） ■ 持有相關專業證照者佳，例如： * 專案管理（PMP、Prince2 等） * IT 服務管理（ITIL 等） * 雲端（AWS、Azure、GCP）、資訊安全、資料或 AI 相關證照 ■ 曾任職於顧問公司或大型集團總部者優先考慮 **你將具備的特質** * 創造實質影響：你的分析與洞察將直接影響客戶高層的商業決策，你將親眼見證策略從藍圖到實現的過程。 * 跨域協作學習：你不是單打獨鬥。你將與 PwC 來自財務、稅務、併購等領域的專家協作，共同打造全面解決方案，快速拓展你的跨領域知識。 * 擁抱觀點與創新：我們鼓勵你挑戰現狀、提出觀點。在這裡，你的想法會被聽見、被討論，並有機會轉化為實際的專案方法論。 * 驅動深遠變革：你參與的專案不僅是技術升級，更是協助企業進行核心的轉型，為產業帶來正向改變。 **為什麼選擇 PwC？** 在 PwC，我們致力於協助你持續成長、走得更遠。我們的人才價值主張代表你將能： * 參與具影響力的專案，為企業與社會創造改變 * 持續投入學習、導師制度與職涯發展 * 在鼓勵創新與重視想法的文化中發揮所長 * 在重視多元與共融的環境中工作，讓每個人都能被看見與被尊重 **下一步** 如果你準備好在PwC展開職涯並創造實質影響，我們期待你的加入。 👉 立即申請，踏出在 PwC 發展的第一步。 **Grow here. Grow further.** 【其他條件】 ■ 3~5 相關工作經驗，具下列其一背景： * 企業端：IT資訊處、轉型辦公室、IT PMO 等單位，實際參與 IT 或數位專案 * 技術顧問/專案管理：Cloud、ERP、CRM、資料平台、資安等領域，參與過大型系統導入或優化專案 * 系統整合顧問/分析師：參與過 IT 導入、流程改善、數位轉型、專案管理等相關專案 ■ 具備基本商業與財務概念：理解預算、成本與效益等概念，願意學習將 IT 專案量化成投資與回報 ■熟悉 PowerPoint、Excel 等常用工具，具備良好文件與報告撰寫能力 ■良好邏輯思考，能以圖表與簡報清楚呈現問題與建議 ■良好溝通表達能力，具備閱讀與撰寫英文文件能力（具英文簡報能力者尤佳） 【加分條件】 ■ 曾參與以下任一類型工作： * 整合多個事業單位/多國或多系統的大型 IT 專案 * 整體 IT 規劃、IT 組織調整、IT 治理或 IT 預算管理 * 併購或重大投資案中的 IT 評估（IT Due Diligence） ■ 持有相關專業證照者佳，例如： * 專案管理（PMP、Prince2 等） * IT 服務管理（ITIL 等） * 雲端（AWS、Azure、GCP）、資訊安全、資料或 AI 相關證照 ■ 曾任職於顧問公司或大型集團總部者優先考慮
